title: Vicor widens AI server power patent fight, seeking new US import ban on Foxconn, Quanta and Delta
content: Vicor Corporation is trying for the second time this year to get AI server power hardware from Taiwan's largest server makers barred from the US. It has won such a ban before.

title: IPC makers expand US production as supply chains, tariffs shift
content: Industrial PC (IPC) makers are adding US manufacturing as supply chains regionalize, tariff policy tightens, and government buyers press for local sourcing. For global readers, the shift signals a broader reordering of electronics production, with more high-value, time-sensitive work moving closer to North American customers.

title: Novatek quarterly revenue tops NT$30B as smartphone demand, edge AI chips lift results
content: Novatek reported stronger September and third-quarter 2026 revenue, suggesting seasonal smartphone demand and growth in edge AI chips are supporting the global display and chip supply chain. The results matter for international readers because they reflect broader shifts in consumer electronics demand, inventory patterns, and AI-related hardware spending.

title: Changs Ascending September revenue jumps 92% on semiconductor plant buildouts
content: Changs Ascending said orders tied to semiconductor customers' new plant construction, equipment arrivals, and project acceptance schedules were gradually fulfilled and recognized as revenue, lifting consolidated revenue to NT$79.2 million (approx. US$2.49 million) in September 2026, up 92% from a month earlier and 14% from a year earlier.

title: Sysgration bets on battery backup, drones to hit US$314 million in sales by 2028
content: Sysgration posted record monthly consolidated revenue in September 2026 for the third consecutive month, pushing third-quarter revenue above NT$1 billion (approx. US$31.4 million) for the first time. At an investor conference on October 7, general manager Tung-Fu Hsieh said recent growth has been driven primarily by rugged industrial PCs (IPCs), while battery backup unit (BBU) shipments are expected to ramp up in the fourth quarter. title: Everlight Chemical September revenue rises on strong electronic chemicals demand
content: Everlight Chemical reported higher September and year-to-date revenue, with electronic chemicals driving most of the growth. The results suggest continued resilience in industrial and specialty materials demand, a trend relevant to global manufacturers, supply chains, and investors watching Asian chemical producers amid uneven market conditions.

title: System integration emerges as Taiwan's next drone industry edge for defense scale-up
content: As defense technology and unmanned vehicles increasingly extend beyond traditional defense industries into the ICT and semiconductor sectors, Taiwan's manufacturers are being urged to go beyond the role of component suppliers and strengthen their system integration (SI) capabilities. That was the message from Lo Cheng-fang, honorary chairman of the Asia UAV Additive Manufacturing Industry Association, at a forum on October 6.

title: Mobile and notebook slowdown boosts wearable sports tech demand
content: Growth in the smartphone and notebook markets is slowing in 2026 as memory price hikes and other factors weigh on shipments. The market even expects that smartphone shipments in 2026 could fall by nearly 17% at the low end. Demand for wearables such as smartwatches and fitness bands, however, is rising, driven by more precise health monitoring and professional sports-tracking features.
